choice_prompt:4:1711145003.text: I can now actually get a full four hours of restful sleep in bed every day! This was simply a luxury a while ago.
choice_prompt:4:1711145003.source_cn: 我现在每天居然能安稳地在床上睡满四个小时了！这在前段时间，简直是奢望。

say:5:1711145004:1.text: Your wisdom saved the entire Department of Affairs!
say:5:1711145004:1.source_cn: 您的智慧拯救了整个事务司！

say:6:1711145006:1.text: Of course, I also owe a lot to Hugh's help. He took on a lot of the miscellaneous tasks of sorting documents for me.
say:6:1711145006:1.source_cn: 当然，这也要多亏了休的帮忙。他帮我分担了大量文书分类的杂务。

choice_prompt:10:1711145008.text: But Lord Merlin is usually so busy, why did you suddenly come today? Is there some troublesome matter outside?
choice_prompt:10:1711145008.source_cn: 不过梅林大人平时那么忙，您今天突然前来，难道是外面又出了什么棘手的事吗？

say:12:1711145010:1.text: The report on the Bantis border... that report was compiled by the late colleague Kraft.
say:12:1711145010:1.source_cn: 班题斯边境的报告……那份报告是由已故的同僚克拉夫特调查整理。

choice_prompt:13:1711145010.text: The report on the Bantis border... that report was compiled by the late colleague Kraft.
choice_prompt:13:1711145010.source_cn: 班题斯边境的报告……那份报告是由已故的同僚克拉夫特调查整理。

say:17:1711145014:1.text: I remember the location! Lord Merlin, please follow me.
say:17:1711145014:1.source_cn: 我记得位置！梅林大人，请跟我来。

choice:10:0:1.text: I'm here to review a report.

choice:4:0:1.text: It seems my efforts weren't in vain.

say:19:1711145005:1.text: Compared to the previous three days when I relied solely on energizing potions to get through it, this is much better.
say:19:1711145005:1.source_cn: 比起之前连续三天只靠提神魔药硬撑，这已经很好了。

choice:4:1:2.text: You've only slept for four hours... You still need to take care of your health.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 才睡四个小时……还要注意身体
